name: Demont's Place
summary: Outlaws hold Demont's Place, west of Moonbrook in southwestern Westfall. Once its fields fed the Kingdom of Stormwind. Economic collapse and the Defias Brotherhood drove the caretakers away, leaving the fields empty and the fences weathered.

sections.title: A Ruined Homestead
sections.body: Demont's Place lies within sight of Moonbrook, among the family holdings that once fed the Kingdom of Stormwind. Economic collapse and outlaw brigands stripped the farm of its livelihood and drove its caretakers away. Now outlaws use its grounds as an extension of the Defias stronghold in Moonbrook.

sections.title: The Grip of the Brotherhood
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood holds Demont's Place on the outskirts of Moonbrook. Thugs, cutpurses, and displaced laborers linger among its fences and shattered buildings. They ambush travelers who stray from the southern roads. Until Moonbrook is reclaimed and the outlaws are broken, peaceful farming cannot return.

faq.answer: Demont's Place lies in southwestern Westfall, immediately west of the abandoned town of Moonbrook.

A settler named Demont likely owned the farm before peasant unrest and economic troubles swept the countryside. Its original inhabitants have long since fled or perished, and brigands now hold the ruined acreage.

aliases: what enemies are at demonts place
faq.answer: Members of the Defias Brotherhood occupy the homestead. They use its ruined grounds as a staging point outside their base in Moonbrook.

faq.q: Can the farm be restored to production?
faq.answer: The farm cannot be restored under current conditions. The Defias hold southern Westfall, and Stormwind cannot spare garrison troops. The homestead remains too dangerous for ordinary tillers to rebuild.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers, Demont's Place shows how far order has retreated from Westfall. Defias outlaws hold former farmland beneath the kingdom's nose.
As a Rogue, you can see the lawless network the Defias Brotherhood has established across the countryside in the ruined plots around Moonbrook, including Demont's Place.
